signal: Rev.io rolled out its all-new AI-native platform for MSPs and telecom providers, won the 2026 MSP Today Product of the Year award, and landed Lyra Communications in May 2026.

email.body1:
Bryan, saw Rev.io rolled out the new AI-native platform, won 2026 MSP Today Product of the Year, and just landed Lyra Communications.

Momentum like that usually means more in-market MSP and telecom accounts than your team can personally touch before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Rev.io off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bryan, quick follow-up for Rev.io.

With the new platform live, pipeline targets usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Rev.io needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bryan, last bit of proof for Rev.io.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rev.io's reply rate likely compares to other telecom and MSP software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bryan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the new platform ramps, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a launch, and I know that stretch keeps a sales team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your MSP and telecom motion? I'll tailor it to Rev.io either way.
